summary: Independent exact-head review of diagnostics generation 17 requests changes: runToggleEvidence protects enabled-window validation, but its unconditional disable(lab) remains a fallible strict path outside the protection. A duplicate/malformed diagnostics root can make both enabled canonical capture and disable root lookup throw, leaving the owned overlay live; strict capture inside disable can also mask the original enabled-window failure after destruction. Require cleanup tied to the exact owned overlay that cannot rediscover/recapture canonical state before destruction, then preserve the original failure. Separate readout visibility finding from test-adversary #474 remains non-duplicated.
evidence: PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.runToggleEvidence captures enabled-window failures in cycleResult, then calls disable(lab) before checking cycleOk.
disable(lab) calls diagnosticsRoot(lab.model) before folder:Destroy(); diagnosticsRoot throws on duplicate same-name roots, wrong class, or missing ownership attribute.

captureCanonicalWhileDiagnosticsEnabled(lab) also begins with diagnosticsRoot(lab.model), so the same duplicate/malformed-root condition can create the captured enabled-window failure and then make cleanup throw before destruction.
After destroying the folder, disable(lab) calls capture(lab); persistent canonical model corruption can make that strict capture throw and mask the original cycleResult.
Existing toggle-failure-cleanup regression proves syntactic ordering of disable before error(cycleResult, 0) but does not prove cleanup itself cannot throw before destroying the exact owned overlay.
Canonical CI 31779941737 and Swarm engine-tests 31779941639 are green on the reviewed head; no Studio/viewport evidence is claimed.

metadata.recommendedNext: Use a cleanup-only failure path tied to the exact overlay instance created by successful enable, with no strict root rediscovery or canonical recapture before destruction; keep full disable/off-state validation on the success path and add a focused regression for cleanup-failure/error-precedence topology.
metadata.separateFinding: PR #474 covers readout Enabled/Visible inspectability and should remain a separate absorbed regression.
